nodes.label: Wave Texture

nodes.label: White Noise Texture

nodes.label: Color Ramp
nodes.limits: RGB LINEAR/CONSTANT use analytic stops; other RGB modes use a native 257-sample LUT with remaining narrow-stop bounds. HSV/HSL, all four hue directions and five interpolation settings, Color/Alpha: native Cycles 257-entry table, linear lookup except CONSTANT floor; factor stays live, no surface bake. Both 4.2/5.3 Cycles CPU and both node-renderer backends tested; EEVEE pixel parity is not claimed.
